rules: every field is {value, definition_status, sources[], raw, null_reason, question, note}; value null => null_reason and question are set
values are copied from read-only sources; nothing is computed from Test/Control; analysis_setup_mixpanel = how the Mixpanel analysis is set up, not confirmed live config
stop_reason applies to stopped tests only; live tests carry null with null_reason "test is live"
related_unlinked = possibly related source mentions that are NOT linked to the test until a person confirms

test_change.definition: What is different for the Test group, in the source wording.
test_change.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)

control_gets.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)

audience.new_vs_old.definition: new / old / both (as set in the named source); raw holds the cut-off definition.
audience.new_vs_old.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)

audience.payer_level.definition: Payer condition of the test population (e.g., non-payers, payers, all), in source wording.
audience.payer_level.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)

audience.platform.definition: Platform(s) in the test (Android / iOS / both).
audience.platform.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)

audience.country.definition: Country condition of the test population.
audience.country.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)

exposure_pct.definition: Share of users in Test, in % as stated by the source. Never derived by us from a group formula; raw keeps the formula.
exposure_pct.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)

lever.definition: One of price / offer / value / purchase_flow / difficulty / reward / screen, only when a source states it or a person confirms it.
lever.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)

primary_metric.definition: The metric the test decision is based on, as named in the source.
primary_metric.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)

guardrails.definition: Metrics that must not drop, as named in the source.
guardrails.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)

hypothesis.definition: The test hypothesis, in source wording.
hypothesis.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)

compliance_requirement.definition: yes / no / unknown: whether the test is required by a platform/legal rule, with the source.
compliance_requirement.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)

stop_reason.definition: For stopped tests only: the stop reason as written in the source. Live tests: null with null_reason "test is live".
stop_reason.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)
